say: I've been loyal through three coaches and two roofs. This week tested me.
Don't talk to me about this place right now. I'm still ringing from the last loss. And the ice.
@how_are_things

options.text: I'm sorry. What would make it better?
It's an old building. Bear with us.
Rinks are hard. Take it or leave it.

say: LUMBER KINGS! Sorry. I get excited. I'm always excited.
{event} tonight. We're due. We're SO due.
This cowbell's had three clappers since 1981. Tonight might be four.

options.text: Think we'll beat Kessler?
Save some voice for the third.

say: Doors aren't even open yet. I like to be first. Same seat since I was six.
Early? I'm not early. Everyone else is late.

options.text: Good to see you anyway.

say: {owner}! The finest owner this rink has ever had. Don't tell Gus I said that.
My owner! I'd ring the cowbell for you but they've asked me not to indoors. Before puck drop.

options.text: Good to see you too, {known_as}.

say: @how_are_things
What can I do for you? Besides cheer?
Hey hey! You ready for the game? I've been ready since Tuesday.

options.text: What's it like being a Lumber Kings fan?
What brings you to the rink?
What do you make of the rink?
What's the word in the stands?
What would make this place better for you?
Take care.

say: It's like being married to a beautiful disaster. I'd do it all again.
1979, we won it all. I've been waiting for the sequel ever since.
Kessler. That's all you need to know. We hate Kessler. Respectfully. Loudly.

options.text: They're lucky to have you.
Tell me a bit about yourself.
Glad you come.
Good to know you, {known_as}.

say: The HOME scoreboard's dead. Doreen's painted numbers do the job. Never needed the 15.
This place is a barn. It's OUR barn.
@ice

options.text: The ice has been better lately, hasn't it?
Noticed the work on the building?
Fair enough. We're working on it.

say: The ice is quick! The boys can actually skate! We might actually win!
That's championship ice. I can feel it in my cowbell.

options.text: Glad it shows.

say: The stands look great! I didn't sit down all game anyway. But I could have.
Somebody cleaned the concourse. I can see the floor. It's blue!

options.text: That's the idea.

say: Stan Szymanski at the rafters rail. Every game since 1974. If we ever win the Cup, nobody knows what he'll do.
Bud Mulroney's 50/50 paid for a fridge. He talks about that fridge like it's a goal in overtime.

options.text: Ha. Good to know.

say: A real goal horn. A loud one. I want the whole valley to hear when we score.
Get us a goal horn. Doreen's organ is lovely but I want to feel it in my teeth.

options.text: I'll see what I can do.
Can't promise anything, but noted.
You're not the first to say it. It's on the list.

say: Go Kings! Sorry. Go you. Then go Kings.
See you at puck drop! I'll be the loud one. One of the loud ones.
